--- /linux/kernel/trace/ring_buffer.c
+++ /linux/kernel/trace/ring_buffer.c
@@ -7205,0 +7206,8 @@
+	/*
+	 * If the pages are already mapped (which can happen if this is
+	 * a split_vma), then vm_insert_pages() will return -EBUSY.

+	 */
+	if (err == -EBUSY)
+		return 0;
